name: Eros
tagline: The near-Earth peanut — first asteroid orbited and landed on by a spacecraft.
history: Eros is a Mars-crossing near-Earth asteroid stretched into a 34-kilometre peanut — one of the most elongated large bodies known. NASA's NEAR Shoemaker spacecraft orbited it for a year in 2000, then touched down on its surface in 2001 — the first asteroid landing. Images showed a regolith-blanketed, cratered world with a surprisingly soft horizon: Eros is not a monolithic rock but a shattered body stitched back together by gravity.
